content.text:
I'm fairly confident only **mp-1217913 (TaTiAlO6)** is present.

1. **Single-phase fits.** I fitted each of the nine candidates alone. TaTiAlO6 was the only one that matched at all, with R = 0.77 at −1.0 % strain. The other eight all had R between 0.97 and 1.00, so they left the strong observed peaks unexplained.
2. **Peak positions.** The main observed peaks are at about 20.1°, 21.9°, 27.55° (the strongest), 34.35° and 36.25° two-theta. These index to a trirutile cell with a ≈ 4.575 Å and c ≈ 8.835 Å, as the (002), (101), (110) and (103) reflections; 34.35° was not indexed. That cell is the TaTiAlO6 cell (a = 4.627 Å, c = 8.934 Å) shrunk by about 1.1 % in both directions, so the fit's −1 % strain is consistent.
3. **Leftover mismatch.** After the TaTiAlO6 fit, the residual still has peaks at 20.1°, 27.55° and 36.3°, and dips (over-fit) near 22°. These fall on TaTiAlO6's own reflections, so they look like wrong relative intensities rather than a second phase. Possible causes are texture or the fit's 0.5 % strain steps; I haven't confirmed either. The weaker peaks above 36°, including 34.35°, are also not clearly explained by any other candidate.

I did not run any two-phase fits, so a minor second phase is not formally ruled out. That is why the confidence is below 0.9.
